title: Silicon-Based CryoEM Grids: Revolutionizing Sample Stability and Data Quality with Microfabrication and Graphene
content: Cryo-electron microscopy (CryoEM) has become an essential tool for determining the structures of small biomolecules, such as proteins, viruses, and DNA. Despite the advancements in CryoEM, the design of the sample carrier (grid) has remained largely unchanged. However, microfabrication techniques, driven by the semiconductor industry, have made significant progress. In this abstract, we present a silicon-based sample carrier using microfabrication techniques to address the limitations of traditional grids.
